incidents.body: We have resolved the issue that prevented users from logging into Calendly.

incidents.body: We are continuing to monitor the system to ensure everything remains stable.
incidents.title: Degraded performance on Calendly.com

incidents.body: The issue has been resolved, and we are closely monitoring the situation to ensure continued stability.
incidents.title: Error on Meetings page

incidents.body: GoToMeeting APIs experienced issues that caused GoToMeeting events to not be created. The issue has now been resolved by GoToMeeting.
incidents.title: GoToMeeting Integration

incidents.body: The team has resolved issues that were preventing users from loading calendly.com
incidents.title: Calendly.com experiencing issues

incidents.body: This morning our engineers identified an issue that may have caused users using IE11 to experience problems with the login and booking flows. All issues have been resolved and we are continuing to monitor to ensure stability.
incidents.title: Issues for IE11 Users

incidents.body: Outlook Desktop functionality has been restored for all users.
incidents.title: Outlook Desktop Plugin

incidents.body: Google has resolved their API issues and all Calendly functionality is now restored.
incidents.title: Deleting an event in your calendar may not cancel Calendly events

incidents.body: Zoom has returned to full functionality and links should resume automatically generating. If you require any additional assistance please reach out to support@calendly.com.
incidents.title: Zoom Video Conferencing Degraded Service

incidents.body: All login services have returned to stable at this time.
incidents.title: Google Login Issues

incidents.body: Zoom has deployed a patch that resolves an issue with OAuth authorizations that affected a small segment of users. We believe that this issue has been resolved. If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to support@calendly.com.
incidents.title: Degraded Connectivity with Zoom Video Conferencing

incidents.body: Service has been fully restored.
incidents.title: Calendly.com experiencing issues

incidents.body: Apple has resolved the issue. iCloud users should no longer be impacted.
incidents.title: iCloud Integration Issues

incidents.body: Fix has been confirmed. Thank you for your patience!
incidents.title: Server Error

incidents.body: This incident has been resolved for all users
incidents.title: Issue Enabling Third Party Integrations

incidents.body: DNS issues affecting logins using the Outlook 365 service appear to have been resolved. If you experience any further issues, please reach out to support@calendly.com
incidents.title: Outlook 365 Login Issues

incidents.body: Issue has been resolved. All calendar events and correspondence should be fully operational.

incidents.body: Calendly site is back up and fully functioning.

incidents.body: The issue has been resolved and we are continuing to monitor performance.

incidents.body:
Stripe has resolved the issue and their billing functionality has been restored within the Calendly system.
https://status.stripe.com/
incidents.title: Stripe billing unavailable

incidents.body: Cloudflare systems have recovered and access to Calendly and Zendesk has been restored. Our developers will continue to monitor going forward.
incidents.title: Calendly down

incidents.body:
Google reports that its services have been fully restored and the issues are now resolved.

More information on the status of the Google Calendar service can be found at https://www.google.com/appsstatus#hl=en&v=issue&sid=2&iid=cc21ebe3962430b2e4ae2b52e3dde98f
incidents.title: Unable to connect to Google Calendar service

incidents.body:
Stripe billing and account upgrade/downgrade functionality have been fully restored.

On 2019-07-10, the Stripe API was unavailable from 16:36–17:02 UTC, and again from 21:14–22:47 UTC. Stripe has confirmed that systems are restored and fully operational.
incidents.title: Stripe unavailable
